description: Marks a person as a manager: they can be set as a person's manager or alternate manager, and as manager they approve that person's time sheets and expenses.
name: tapr

description: Can create and edit legacy POs that are entered by hand, and see them in any status, while the legacy PO setting is on.
name: legacy_po_create_update

description: Can commit approved time sheets, expenses and time amendments, reject approved ones, see the commit queue and the tracking screens, and ignore missing time sheets.
name: commit

description: Lets the holder choose the Corporate branch on their time entries, expenses and POs, and have Corporate as their default branch.
name: corporate_branch

description: Can be chosen as a PO approver and approve POs up to the limits that an admin sets for them, for each kind of PO and for their divisions. With no limits, the claim does nothing.
name: po_approver

description: Can merge duplicate clients, client contacts and vendors into one record, undo the latest merge of each type, and see the Absorb Actions list.
name: absorb

description: System administrator: can edit admin profiles, assign claims and approval limits, see committed time sheets and expenses, renumber or delete jobs, and manage currencies, rate sheet rates, machine secrets and attachment audits.
name: admin

description: Not in use. Turbo does not check this claim.
name: accounting

description: Procurement: can create and edit jobs, clients, contacts and rate sheets, close projects, change the client of a project, create jobs from approved project requests, and propose project value changes.
name: job

description: Can create a new revision of a rate sheet, and change the rate sheet of a job that already has one. To edit the job, the holder also needs the job claim.
name: rate_sheet_revise

description: Can add time types. The Time Types screen is in the menu only for an admin, so give this claim together with admin.
name: tt

description: Can create, edit and delete time amendments for any employee until they are committed, and view all amendments. To commit one, the holder needs the commit claim.
name: tame

description: Read-only access for reports: the payroll, weekly and payables reports, all committed time sheets and expenses, the tracking screens, everyone's time off, time amendments, work records, PO approver limits, and Closed or Cancelled POs.
name: report

description: Can search work records and see every employee's time entries on each one.
name: work_record

description: Basic staff access, given at the first sign-in: enter your own time and bundle it into time sheets, create and submit project requests, and add vendors and client invoicing profiles.
name: time

description: Can view all admin profiles and edit each person's time off opening date, opening balances and payroll ID.
name: time_off_manager

description: Marks a person as a business development lead, so that they can be picked as the lead of a client. It gives the holder no other access.
name: busdev

description: Payables staff: can cancel an Active PO that has no expenses, close an Active Cumulative or Recurring PO, convert a One-Time PO to Cumulative, settle foreign-currency expenses, create, edit and delete vendors, and enter On Account expenses over the no-PO limit.
name: payables_admin

description: Can view all admin profiles and edit their HR fields: active status, job title, phone, default branch, charge-out rate, salary, payroll ID, time off opening balances and time sheet settings.
name: hr

description: Can enter On Account or corporate card expenses against another person's Active PO for that person, becomes the approver of those expenses, and can reuse a receipt that another expense already has.
name: book_keeper

description: Can view each user's sign-in identity, set the legacy user ID, remove a linked sign-in provider, and make users who are not admins active or inactive.
name: it

description: Can view the KPI reports, the Branch and Division WIP reports, and Branch Hours for every branch.
name: kpi

description: Can be chosen to approve project requests and project value changes when the full project value is within the holder's limit. An admin must set that limit, or the claim does nothing.
name: project_authorization

description: Can create a group of POs for other staff from one template PO and a CSV upload, and see every PO of a group in any status.
name: super_po

description: Invoicing staff: can create draft client invoices, bill back expenses and POs on them, issue them, and see every client invoice.
name: invoicing
